The '''Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School''' was a terrorist act by [[Ort Hoogra-D'En]]. He detonated a [[spore bomb]] that killed 45 people, including [[Jared Brojtal]]'s son. This caused a 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bounty to be issued for Ort's capture.
